sites.name: Son La Prison Special National Relic
sites.event: The place where the French colonialists imprisoned and exiled loyal communists (such as To Hieu, Le Duan...), famous for the To Hieu peach tree.

sites.name: Son La Hydropower Plant
sites.event: The largest hydropower plant in Southeast Asia (at the time of inauguration), a key national project on the Da River.

sites.name: Ta Xua Peak (Dinosaur Backbone)
sites.event: A famous cloud-hunting paradise in the North, featuring a mountain range shaped like a dinosaur's backbone stretching out into a floating sea of clouds.

sites.name: Dai Yem Waterfall (Nang Waterfall)
sites.event: Associated with the legend of a girl's silk sash used to save a young man from floodwaters.

sites.name: Ban Ang Pine Forest
sites.event: Likened to a 'miniature Da Lat' of the Northwest with a natural lake and vast green pine forests.

sites.name: Pha Luong Peak
sites.event: The roof of Moc Chau plateau, a landmark featured in the poem 'Tay Tien' by Quang Dung ('Whose house in Pha Luong, rain in the far distance').

sites.name: Que Lam Ngu Che Stele
sites.event: The place where King Le Thai Tong's poem was carved into the cliff in 1440 after his inspection tour of the Northwest region.

sites.name: Heart-shaped Tea Hill
sites.event: A symbol of Moc Chau tourism, where tea rows are skillfully planted to form a heart shape.

sites.name: Bat Cave (Son Moc Huong Cave)
sites.event: Known as the 'First Cave of the West', the most beautiful limestone cave in the Moc Chau plateau region.

sites.name: Pa Uon Bridge
sites.event: The bridge with the tallest piers in Vietnam (at the time of construction) spanning the reservoir of the Son La Hydropower Plant.

sites.name: Na Ka Plum Valley
sites.event: The largest hau plum valley in Moc Chau, brilliantly beautiful during the white blossom season or the fruit harvesting season.

sites.name: Moc Ly Fort Historical Relic
sites.event: The site of the battle that destroyed Moc Ly Fort (1952), an important victory that opened the Northwest liberation campaign.
